constraints: No real model calls in POC stage
design.subject_motion: primary subject moves with readable silhouette and clear intent
design.music: hybrid cinematic pulse with evolving texture

risks.action: May over-specify movement and reduce visual freedom.
risks.emotion: May exaggerate performance and reduce subtlety.
risks.character: May add constraints that conflict with style.
risks.audio: May overfit timing before real audio exists.
risks.prompt: May make prompts longer and harder to execute.

action.note: Strengthen the action beat with a clearer before/after movement cue.
action.motion: Make the subject motion more readable, with a concrete gesture, direction, and visible reaction.
action.prompt: Emphasize explicit action staging, readable silhouettes, and a decisive visual anchor.
action.effect: Action intent should become easier to evaluate and less ambiguous.

emotion.scene: Increase the emotional objective so the beat has a clearer feeling change.
emotion.shot: Add visible expression, posture, or reaction detail that makes the intended emotion measurable.
emotion.prompt: Specify emotional performance cues and reaction timing without changing the core scene.
emotion.effect: Emotional intensity should become more legible in the generated result.

prompt.prompt: Clarify executable prompt constraints: subject, action, camera, timing, and success criteria.
prompt.effect: Prompt execution should become more constrained and easier to score.

character.behavior: Keep the character identity, silhouette, and behavioral intent consistent across the affected shots.
character.prompt: Preserve the same character identity, wardrobe logic, silhouette, and behavior continuity.
character.effect: Character continuity should become easier to track across the sequence.

scene.scene: Clarify spatial layout, foreground/background relationship, and scene anchor.
scene.shot: Add a readable environment anchor so the shot location remains stable.
scene.prompt: Specify the location anchor, spatial layers, and stable environmental details.
scene.effect: Scene continuity and spatial readability should improve.

camera.camera: Tie camera movement directly to the narrative focal point.
camera.prompt: Describe camera framing, lens distance, and the visual reason for the movement.
camera.effect: Camera language should support the story beat more clearly.

audio.sound: Place a clear audio cue on the visual beat that needs emphasis.
audio.prompt: Sync the key visual beat with a concrete sound cue or music change.
audio.effect: Audio timing should become easier to align with the visual rhythm.
